arc.fallback: The Wind, the Chariot, and Wamuu

description.fallback: Wamuu's hand comes out of the horse and grabs Joseph's leg. Wamuu tries to crushes his leg to prevent him from sending a Ripple into Wamuu's hand, but JoJo leaps off the horse, with Wamuu only holding on to his boot. JoJo lands back on the horses, proclaiming that luck was on his side.
